song: # One row per correction
# correct_notes.py. Never edits merged/ - writes corrected/<song>.mid.
# song            - matches a merged/<song>.mid filename
# onset_time      - the note's current onset in seconds (as transcribed)
# original_pitch  - the note's current MIDI pitch
# new_pitch       - the corrected MIDI pitch
#                    remove the note entirely
# new_onset       - optional: corrected onset in seconds; leave blank to
#                    keep the note's current onset
# new_offset      - optional: corrected offset in seconds; leave blank to
#                    keep the note's current offset
# onset_time/original_pitch just need to get close enough to identify the
# note - correct_notes.py matches by pitch plus onset within a tolerance
# (default 50ms
# Example - fix a note that should have been F# (66) instead of G (67)
# found via inspect_range.py or rank_review_candidates.py's flagged
# segments. Uncomment and edit to use:
# 1nonly - Meaningless Love (Official Music Video)
# Example - delete a spurious note entirely (new_onset/new_offset ignored
# for a deletion):
# 163braces - 過期 (lyrics music video)
